tests.name: MemManager_TwoRank
tests.description: Two-rank peer export/import internal Suspend/Resume tests on raw VMM

tests.name: SuspendResume_Basic
tests.description: Basic public ncclCommSuspend/Resume cycle, multi-cycle, barrier sync

tests.name: SuspendResume_MemStats

tests.name: SuspendResume_CollectiveIntegrity
tests.description: AllReduce/P2p auto-mark and rebuild after Suspend/Resume

test_suites.name: MemManager - Fixtures (single-process, Debug build)

test_suites.name: MemManager - MPI (Internal API)
